rites.name: Cradon
rites.text: Cradon is the concept of a threshold, the moment a closed door is about to open, as understood by the councils of Theisasha during the Courts. It is invoked in trials where judges weigh whether a passage between worlds should be made.

rites.name: Thadock
rites.text: Thadock is a concept within Theisasha, a notion held by the Courts of the Outer Realm that a single will can bind the flames of the Holy Age into a door between worlds. It is remembered as the idea that the first councils argued over before any temple was raised.

rites.name: Zepheisseth
rites.text: Zepheisseth is a quiet-minded lattice of cold stellar engineers who weave resonant threads through dying suns to keep their light sustained across the outer voids of Theisasha. Its builders regard the entity as a gentle guardian, though its occasional recalibrations have scoured whole star systems clean.

rites.name: Torukoth
rites.text: Torukoth is the concept of Theisasha's branching futures, the moment in the Three Futures when a single ending splits and every outcome is sorted onto the shelves of the Library. It is less a being than a hinge that holds the weight of all the paths that were never taken.
